About me

Engineering with reliability in mind.

I'm a Software Engineer with 3 years of experience building backend systems and payment-processing solutions in the fintech domain. My work has centered on Java, Spring Boot, scalable microservices, distributed systems, messaging, and system integration.

I've worked on production payment systems where reliability and interoperability are critical—from modernizing Apache Camel across major versions and engineering ISO 20022 and SWIFT message structures to optimizing build pipelines and adding safeguards against duplicate transactions.

I enjoy solving engineering problems that improve reliability, scalability, and maintainability while making development and delivery more efficient.
